title: koeleria pumila
intro: Koeleria pumila, commonly known as Little Koel or Dwarf June Grass, is a species of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria pumila include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, possibly attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids. However, the exact bioactive constituents and their effects may vary, and further research is needed to confirm its therapeutic potential and potential health benefits.
